text:
Ariel Gomez: spontaneous idea  ice cream truck rolling by the office for an afternoon treat next Wednesday 3:30pm? small meetup in the courtyard. :ice_cream:
Ben Liu: love it. what time window does the truck do? i have a 3:15 call so might be a tad late.
Carmen Ortiz: they said 3:1504:00 window. perfect for a quick midweek sugar boost.
Diego Ramos: can they do dairy-free sorbet? im lactose intolerant.
Ariel Gomez: @Diego i asked  vendor confirmed dairy-free and vegan sorbet options. price around $4/item if we do group order.
Eli Zhang: can we do a tiny poll: 1) sorbet only 2) ice cream + sorbet 3) let people choose individually
Ben Liu: 3
Carmen Ortiz: 2
Diego Ramos: 1 (sad but practical)
Ariel Gomez: leaning 3 so ppl pick. quick logistics: bringing cash helpful but they accept card. would people want us to put this on the social card and settle after?
Ben Liu: social card fine. maybe we set a $6/head cap so its not open tab.
Carmen Ortiz: fine by me.
Eli Zhang: ill make a 1-click RSVP form with flavor prefs: https://tinyurl.com/rw-ice-cream-truck (pls add dietary notes)
EventBot: Event created: "Ice Cream Truck Chill" Wed 3:30PM  invited: #lunch-plans.
Ariel Gomez: copy-paste checklist for volunteers:
```
- confirm final headcount by 2pm Wed
- hold courtyard spot (red blanket) at 3:15
- collect cash backup for folks who prefer to pay cash
- bring small bowls/napkins for sharing samples
```
Ben Liu: i can hold the blanket and handle cash backup.
Carmen Ortiz: ill run the RSVP list and check dietary notes.
Diego Ramos: ill bring extra spoons.
Ariel Gomez: perfect. will post a reminder Tue. thanks yall! :ice_cream:
